name: Taiwan Union Technology Corporation
summary: Taiwan Union Technology Corporation is a global enterprise active within the electronics industry. The firm specializes in the production of core materials like copper-clad laminates, prepreg, and mass laminates, in addition to supplying printed circuit boards. These products are vital for diverse applications, including radio frequency systems, high-speed digital infrastructure, high-density interconnect solutions, automotive electronics, and various substrate requirements. Established in 1974, the company's primary operations are based in Zhubei, Taiwan, having previously operated under the name Taiwan Union Glass Industrial Co., Ltd.
